items.title: Ethereum's Co-Founder Takes On Crypto's Next Security Threat. Who Is Vitalik Buterin?
items.summary: Key takeaways Vitalik Buterin’s November 26 essay argues that crypto security must extend to the physical chips inside devices, summed up as “Not your silicon, not your keys.” He wants manufacturers to publish physical chip layouts (GDS files) so investigators can compare real hardware against the design. Researcher Andrew Huang’s infrared inspection technique (IRIS) can examine chips without removing them, but it has resolution limits and is not a universal fix. items.title: Monero's Delisting Nightmare Continues: XMR Price Plunges 15%
items.summary: Key takeaways Monero fell about 15% on Thursday, from $525.36 to $446.54 per BitInfoCharts, after KuCoin announced it will delist XMR. KuCoin will end all four XMR spot pairs on November 30 at 08:00 UTC; deposits are already suspended and withdrawals stay open until December 31. XMR will also stop being accepted as collateral for VIP loans, so borrowers may need to add other collateral to avoid liquidation. items.title: AI Projects Lead Trading in MEXC's October Listings; Top 10 Gainers Average 1,168% at Their Peaks
items.summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, November 26, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has released trading data for its October listings. Three of the five new tokens with the highest Spot trading volume were AI projects. Among the 10 new tokens with the largest price gains, the average peak gain was 1,168%. The gainers spanned sectors including GameFi, AI, infrastructure, and memecoins. October’s Spot trading volumes show how interest in AI translated into trading activity. AXIS, CLAUDIA, and DNA ranked first, second, and fourth, respectively, among the month’s new listings by Spot volume.
